title: Orbit workspace configuration
description: Schema for .orbit/workspace.yaml. Kept consistent with crates/workspace/src/config.rs.

version.description: Configuration schema version. Only 1 is currently supported.

projects.description: Map of registered project name to its location and identity. Each entry is a normal, independent Orbit project with its own .orbit/project.yaml.

path.description: Workspace-relative (or absolute) filesystem path to the project. Must resolve inside the workspace root -- a `..` escape, an absolute path elsewhere, or a symlink escape fails the whole workspace load.

aliases.description: Alternate names this project can be resolved by. Must not collide with another project's name or another project's alias.

relationships.description: Directional, purely descriptive relationships between registered projects. Never used to grant or infer access between projects.

project.description: Used for safe, read-only overview questions and single-project commands issued at the workspace root with nothing else selected. Must name a registered project. Never used for commands that change anything (e.g. `orbit run`), which always require an explicit --project.

permissions.description: Permissions for the workspace.* actions themselves (distinct from each project's own `permissions`, which always still governs the per-project native action a workspace action delegates to). Every workspace.* action defaults to allow.
